# CLI commands

!!! info "Generated from the code"
    Generated by `scripts/gen_docs.py` — do not edit by hand. Run the script after changing the code.

Administration commands, from `backend/app/cli.py: build_parser()`. Run them in the API container (as shown) or, outside Docker, from the `backend` folder with `python -m app.cli ...`.

## `create-admin`

Create the hospital (if needed) and an administrator account.

```bash
docker exec -it careflow-api-1 python -m app.cli create-admin --name ... --email ...
```

| Option | Required | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--hospital` | no | Hospital name; needed only when the database has no hospital yet. |
| `--name` | yes | The administrator's full name. |
| `--email` | yes | The administrator's sign-in email. |
| `--password` | no | Password (12+ characters). Omit to be asked without echoing it. |

## `reset-password`

Set a new password for an account and unlock it.

```bash
docker exec -it careflow-api-1 python -m app.cli reset-password --email ...
```

| Option | Required | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--email` | yes | Email of the account to reset. |
| `--password` | no | New password (12+ characters). Omit to be asked without echoing it. |

## `load-examples`

Add two clearly labelled test patients, admitted but not yet authorized.

```bash
docker exec -it careflow-api-1 python -m app.cli load-examples
```

No options.

## `sync-beds`

Fill the bed board from admitted patients' ward and bed (run once after upgrading).

```bash
docker exec -it careflow-api-1 python -m app.cli sync-beds
```

No options.
